prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium fantasy RPG inventory icon for Frostguard, tier 90 Aurora melee armor. Original new artwork. Shared design: elegant forged dark midnight-blue steel with smooth curved plate construction, cool silver beveled edges, narrow antique-gold engraved trim, rich teal-to-violet iridescent enamel inlays shaped like flowing aurora ribbons. Strong contrast between dark steel recesses and controlled colored highlights; detailed fine celestial engraving visible at large size with a simple readable silhouette at 48 pixels. High quality hand-painted 3D product illustration, upper-left soft studio lighting, three-quarter view, complete item centered occupying about 78 percent of square with generous clear margins. Actual transparent alpha background, never a painted checkerboard. No wearer, mannequin, skin, body parts, pedestal, ground, scenery, cast background shadow, text, border, logo, watermark or extra props. Absolutely no animal theme: no cat or tiger face, ears, muzzle, fangs, claws, paws, stripes, fur, animal emblems, horns or animal-shaped ornaments. Magic is iridescent material color, not an aura.
Subject: One empty closed human knight helmet: smooth rounded enclosed crown, single low central swept-back metal ridge, straight narrow horizontal visor slit, angular flat human faceplate and fitted gorget. Refined heroic knight silhouette; use a low central ridge, no pointed side projections that could read as ears.
sourceLookup: Owner requested Frostguard item icons be regenerated because the cat/tiger look was wrong. Original text-only Aurora knight artwork, independent of the current equipped 3D model. No marketplace images supplied to image generation.
review: Root and fresh read-only critic reviewed the original, 256px master and 48px derivative. Complete human knight armor silhouette with teal/violet Aurora enamel, dark blue steel and silver edges; no animal motifs, fur or separate claws. Production lab loaded all five staged icons and matching helm hover facts without browser errors. Transparent edges and consumer padding pass.
